items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 109:1
items.html: The membrane of the Avir is discerned as the firmament that separates between the Galgalta, which was corrected in the MEM of Tzelem, over which the screen of the mouth of Atik does not rule, and the Sealed Brain, which was already diminished by the power of the screen of Atik. And likewise the lower seven of the Galgalta came out to the aspect of the Sealed Brain, for their lower seven could not receive the correction of the MEM of Tzelem, being the roots of ZON, and hence they became a separate head — Mocha deAvira. See Answer 38 above. Thus the membrane of the Avir became a firmament separating between the Galgalta, which is the aspect of the upper waters over which no screen separates to Atik, and between the Avir and the Sealed Brain, which are the lower waters, for the power of the screen of Atik rules over them and they are diminished by it. (Page 327, Item 72).
